Public resource detected.impact: May expose sensitive data to unauthorized access
Public resource detected.fix: Disable public access and restrict to VPC only

Public storage bucket detected.impact: Critical data exposure risk - any internet user can read bucket contents
Public storage bucket detected.fix: Make storage bucket private immediately and enable Block Public Access

Public database exposed.impact: Critical data breach risk - database is reachable from the internet
Public database exposed.fix: Restrict database access to VPC only and remove public endpoint

Encryption disabled.impact: Data not protected at rest - violates PCI-DSS and data protection standards
Encryption disabled.fix: Enable encryption at rest using KMS or service-managed keys

Logging not enabled.impact: Cannot track security events or meet compliance audit requirements
Logging not enabled.fix: Enable CloudTrail/audit logging and ship logs to centralized store

Idle resource.impact: Unnecessary cost incurred with minimal business value delivered
Idle resource.fix: Stop or downsize instance to reduce monthly spend

Unused resource.impact: 100% cost waste - resource delivers zero value
Unused resource.fix: Delete unused resource to eliminate wasted spend

Suspicious login activity detected.message: Multiple failed login attempts detected via CloudTrail
Suspicious login activity detected.impact: Potential credential stuffing or brute-force attack in progress
Suspicious login activity detected.fix: Enable MFA, rotate credentials, review and restrict IAM policies

Known vulnerabilities detected.impact: Known CVEs can be exploited by attackers to gain unauthorized access
Known vulnerabilities detected.fix: Apply security patches and review SecurityHub findings for CVE details

Stale resource - no activity for 90+ day.message: No CloudTrail activity recorded for over 90 days
Stale resource - no activity for 90+ day.impact: Orphaned resource increasing attack surface and wasting budget
Stale resource - no activity for 90+ day.fix: Validate business need and decommission if no longer required

Rightsizing opportunity identified.message: Cost Explorer identifies significant savings potential
Rightsizing opportunity identified.impact: Overspending on underutilized resources reduces cloud ROI
Rightsizing opportunity identified.fix: Rightsize to a smaller instance type based on actual utilization metrics

SSH port (22) exposed to internet.message: SSH port is publicly reachable from any IP address
SSH port (22) exposed to internet.impact: High-risk attack vector for brute-force, credential theft, and lateral movement
SSH port (22) exposed to internet.fix: Restrict SSH to specific VPN IP ranges or use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager

RDP port (3389) exposed to internet.message: RDP port is publicly reachable from any IP address
RDP port (3389) exposed to internet.impact: Critical risk - RDP is a primary target for ransomware and remote exploits
RDP port (3389) exposed to internet.fix: Restrict RDP to VPN only, enable Network Level Authentication, enforce MFA

Active compliance violations detected.message: AWS Config has flagged active compliance rule violations
Active compliance violations detected.impact: Regulatory non-compliance risks fines, audit failures, and reputational damage
Active compliance violations detected.fix: Review all violations in AWS Config and implement required controls

Resource missing required tags.message: Resource has no tags for cost allocation or governance
Resource missing required tags.impact: Cannot attribute costs to teams or enforce governance policies
Resource missing required tags.fix: Apply mandatory tags: env, team, project, owner
